chapterName: Administrative Procedures Act; Review of Rules; Civil Penalties
reviewBasis: Read directly from the frozen source's own plain text (markup stripped with no section-segmentation logic applied) and cross-checked against the raw HTML markup, using the same auditable-script method validated on chapter 105: every ... run matching a bare section-number-plus-heading pattern was extracted directly from the frozen source, independent of parse_ors_chapter.py. All 83 resulting operative catchlines were cross-checked against the chapter's own printed table of contents -- 83/83 matched, zero extra, zero missing. The remaining 26 sections omitted from the table of contents were found by a second script pass over the body text for bare section numbers immediately followed by a bracketed legislative-history citation, each manually inspected in context. Eight of those 26 (183.010 through 183.090) are historical numbers from the chapter's pre-1971 numbering scheme, printed together as a block immediately before the first live section (183.310) rather than scattered between table-of-contents entries -- the same disused-number convention as chapter 12's and 105's stubs, just concentrated at the head of the chapter instead of spread through it.

methodology.catchlineExtractionMethod: auditable script over raw <b> markup, not parse_ors_chapter.py
methodology.stubDetectionMethod: auditable script matching bare section number + bracketed legislative-history citation, manually inspected
